name: Queendomia: Black & Pink
summary:
Black & Pink is a 3D BDSM simulation game focused on a female led LGBTQ+ dynamic, where players can experience the game from different perspectives. Create your contract, choose your role, and follow your own path through a collection of interactive scenes, tasks, and situations.

The game combines stylized realism with detailed 3D characters, dynamic interactions, physics based effects, and a growing selection of scenarios. Players can explore the world freely and choose which tasks and interactions they want to pursue.
